segment.description: Cameron Brown Lake, the small fishing pond in the City of Germantown's Cameron Brown Park (Shelby County), TN — a TWRA Region 1 winter put-and-take trout water. TWRA's live stocking table lists 'Cameron Brown Lake' (Region 1, Shelby County) with Winter-type rainbow trout stockings on 1/13/2026 and 'TBD 12/2026'; TWRA's 11/26/2025 winter-program press release counts Germantown among the five-creel-limit Community Lakes sites.
segment.boundaries: Entire lake in Cameron Brown Park, Germantown, Shelby County, TN; TWRA Region 1 winter stocking program site (stockings in the Nov/Dec-Mar cold window only).

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source evidence of any kind found. City of Germantown pages were unreachable (HTTP 403 to fetchers), so no city-level lake characterization was available; the only cited characterization is TWRA program-level.

holdover.detail: No site-level holdover documentation found in any consulted source. Program-level context: TWRA's Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 states hatchery-supported streams and lakes 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round.'

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout record for this lake. TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027: 'Wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams.' No source consulted places any wild trout in this Germantown park lake.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TWRA stocks this Germantown park lake with rainbow trout only in the winter program (1/13/2026 + TBD 12/2026 rows), and TWRA's own plan says warmwater hatchery-supported waters cannot support trout year round.

sourcesChecked: https://www.tn.gov/twra/news.html (miss: release list is JS-rendered; no lake-level pages retrieved)
